article.title: The global left’s mood of resignation must be lifted: The Forty-Sixth Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Vijay Prashad
article.content: The far right can be defeated, and the openings multiplying from Brazil to India and the United States demand that movements exchange defeatism for confidence that can become a material force through organisation.
